text_block_list.name: Sonon Elfie
text_block_list.text:
"Everyooone!!
Are you getting your exerciseee!?"

text_block_list.name: Sonon Elfie
text_block_list.text: “Hiyah!!”

text_block_list.name: Sonon Elfie
text_block_list.text:
“—Hello there!
I love sports, and shining sweat connects the world!”

text_block_list.name: Sonon Elfie
text_block_list.text: "Your thrilling athletic UmaTuber, Sonon Elfie, here!!"

text_block_list.name: Elfie's Fan A
text_block_list.text: —Wait, Elfi's new release is out!

text_block_list.name: Elfie's Fan B
text_block_list.text:
No way, even though she updated yesterday too?
Oooh, let's watch! I wonder what she's doing this time.

text_block_list.name: Sonon Elfie
text_block_list.text: "This time's Elfy Challenge is... this!"

text_block_list.name: Sonon Elfie
text_block_list.text: "‘Ta-da! It's a super-super-super gigantic vaulting box!!’"

text_block_list.name: Elfie's Fan C
text_block_list.text:
—Eh, wait, whoa!
How many tiers does this have!?

text_block_list.name: Elfie's Fan D
text_block_list.text:
"Didn't she just smash the human world record with ease?
Even for an Umamusume, is this really possible...?"

text_block_list.name: Sonon Elfie
text_block_list.text: "Aaaall right, let's goooo!!"

text_block_list.name: Sonon Elfie
text_block_list.text: "Hmph!!!"

text_block_list.name: Sonon Elfie
text_block_list.text: “—Haaaaaaaaah!!”

text_block_list.name: Sonon Elfie
text_block_list.text: "Oryaaaaaaaahhhhhh!!!"

text_block_list.name: Sonon Elfie
text_block_list.text: "—All right! The challenge was a total, smashing success~!!"

text_block_list.name: Academy Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
—Elfie really is incredible...!
I wonder if we could jump this too?

text_block_list.name: Academy Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
No, they train completely different parts of their body than we do!
They've gotta be doing specialized workouts for that sort of thing.

text_block_list.name: Academy Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Guess so~. Elfi's videos always look so fun, it really makes you want to try it yourself!

"...Lately, both inside and outside the academy,
an Umamusume streamer named 'Sonon Elfie' has become quite popular."
She streams herself challenging various athletic feats, making full use of an Umamusume's physical abilities—

She gained popularity for her ability to perform at a high
level in any sport, and for how she always looked like
she was genuinely having fun while being active.

Today as well, while noticing the Academy's Umamusume
lively chatting away about Sonon Elfie's stream—
choice_data_list: Alright, I've got to get to the meeting spot...!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Everyone!
Thank you all for gathering here despite your busy schedules!
All the academy trainers gathered in the gymnasium turned their eyes toward Chairwoman Akikawa on the stage.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
I have gathered you all here today to
announce the holding of a certain event!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Presenting!
Ms. Ryoka Tsurugi, step right this way!

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text:
“—To all the Trainers of Tracen Academy.
Thank you very much for taking time out
of your busy schedules to be here.”

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for the introduction, Chairwoman Akikawa.
My name is Ryoka Tsurugi, and I am serving as the event producer.

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text:
To all of you, we present a brand-new
sports entertainment produced by us—

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text:
'Uma Musume Athletic Festival.'
I have come to announce the holding of the 'U.A.F.'
—What is the U.A.F.?!

text_block_list.name: Sonon Elfie
text_block_list.text:
Challenging the physical limits of Umamusume,
it's an unprecedentedly sparkling sports meet!!

text_block_list.name: Sonon Elfie
text_block_list.text:
—Athlete Umamusume competing against each other
in 15 unique, unconventional events!

text_block_list.name: Sonon Elfie
text_block_list.text: Based on those total points, we will determine who is the No. 1 Athlete Umamusume!!

text_block_list.name: Sonon Elfie
text_block_list.text:
The ultimate festival that gets everyone fired up!
The pinnacle of sports entertainment!!

text_block_list.name: Sonon Elfie
text_block_list.text:
And that! Is what!!
The 'U.A.F.' is all about!!!

text_block_list.name: Sonon Elfie
text_block_list.text:
"...Oh, where are my manners! Pardon me for not introducing myself sooner!
My name is Sonon Elfie!"

text_block_list.name: Sonon Elfie
text_block_list.text: I usually work as an athletic Umamutuber, but—

text_block_list.name: Sonon Elfie
text_block_list.text: I will be serving as the promotional character for U.A.F. with absolute precision!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
"—Some of you may already know her.
She is an alumna of this very Tracen Academy!"
choice_data_list: (She was a former Tracen Academy student...!)
(So she used to be a Tracen Academy student...!)

text_block_list.name: Academy Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
...Still, a sports festival with 15 different events...?
So it's not a race, then?

text_block_list.name: Academy Trainer B
text_block_list.text:
"Why did the Chairwoman announce
this tournament to us...?"

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: "To the main topic! I shall explain the reason we announced the 'U.A.F.'!"

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
As the foremost institution for training Umamusume athletes,
Tracen Academy was asked by Ms. Tsurugi to help
make the event a resounding success!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: High hopes! By hosting the U.A.F., the academy sees immense potential to bring even greater excitement to the entire Umamusume sports world!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Determination! Tracen Academy believes in its potential
and officially endorses hosting the U.A.F.!
(Murmur, murmur, murmur...!)

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: However! This only applies to the Academy on an organizational level! The Trainers and students are a different matter!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: "I want you to keep chasing dreams alongside Umamusume in races, just as you always have!"

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
“However, if you Trainers discuss it with your
assigned Umamusume and find true meaning
in participating in the 'U.A.F.'—”

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
The academy won't stop you from participating!
In fact, I promise we will support you with all our might!

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text:
Currently, the U.A.F. includes athlete Umamusume
active in fields outside of racing, as well as—

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text:
Including Sonon Elfie here,
many Umamusume formerly affiliated with
Tracen Academy are scheduled to participate.

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text:
—We are truly aiming to make the U.A.F.
an entertainment spectacle on par with racing itself.

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text:
Please consider utilizing the experience gained from
this new festival of athlete Umamusume
in your future endeavors.

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text: —We plan to hold an information session for prospective participants at a later date.

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text:
The details will be sent to your work email addresses
shortly, so anyone interested, please check there.

text_block_list.name: Sonon Elfie
text_block_list.text:
Let's compete together, elevate each other,
and forcefully carve open new possibilities
as athlete Umamusume!

text_block_list.name: Sonon Elfie
text_block_list.text: Please, I'm counting on you!!

—The next day.
While reading the email from Ryoka Tsurugi,
I thought about what to do next.

—Training in a wide variety of sports
and competing against various athlete Umamusume in tournaments—
that is an invaluable experience, hard to come by even if one seeks it.
If it goes well, this might prove useful in <chrname>'s future races...!

"...Afterward, I talked it over with <chrname>,
sharing my thoughts—"

After getting <chrname>'s understanding,
it was decided that I would first attend
the U.A.F. briefing session.
A few days later—

Arriving at the briefing venue, I looked around.
...It seemed only a few Trainers from Tracen Academy,
including myself, were in attendance.

They likely passed on participating out of a desire
to keep their trainee focused on the races.
As a fellow Trainer, it's not hard to imagine—
choice_data_list: (But that's exactly why it's a chance.)

text_block_list.text:
If only there were "something" to be gained
precisely because I participated in this U.A.F.—
"That will surely serve as invaluable fuel for only <chrname> to reach even greater heights!"

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text:
Everyone. Thank you very much for taking the time out of your busy schedules
to attend the "U.A.F." briefing.

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text: "Without further ado, let us go over the upcoming schedule using the materials in front of you—"

"...I was listening so intently that the briefing
ended in the blink of an eye. To summarize today's discussion—"
—The U.A.F. takes place over the course of two years.
These two years are broadly divided into the qualifiers and the finals—

Qualifiers are held once every six months nationwide,
for a total of three times. The top performers based on the combined
results of all three will advance to the finals.

And the finals are scheduled to take place at the end of the two years,
at a venue even larger than the qualifiers.

"The victor here will earn the glory
of being crowned the No. 1 Athlete Umamusume—"

"...However, that doesn't mean we are
holding the 'U.A.F.' right away this year."
According to Ryoka Tsurugi, they plan to hold a test tournament this December that mirrors the real deal.

It seems they'll be using this test tournament
to verify operations and conduct promotions
leading up to the main event.
Furthermore, an announcement was made strongly encouraging those wishing to participate in the tournament to compete in this test tournament as well.
"...If you are serious about participating in the U.A.F. and achieving results, there is certainly value in running in this test event."

This will serve as the touchstone to see if <chrname>
has what it takes to grow as an athlete through the U.A.F....!

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text:
“—You were listening to me
so very attentively, weren't you?”

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text: What do you think? Did today's conversation spark your interest in the 'U.A.F.'?
choice_data_list: As of now, I'm positively considering participating.

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much.
I am honored to receive such words from a Tracen Academy Trainer right away.

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text:
Together, let us create a new form of entertainment
that will make everyone's hearts race with excitement.

As she said that, a glimpse of strong determination
could be seen in Ryoka Tsurugi's eyes—

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text:
“—We are genuinely aiming to make 'U.A.F.'
an entertainment that stands alongside racing.”

—It made me realize once again
that the words spoken back then were not a lie.
choice_data_list: I'm looking forward to working with you!

text_block_list.text:
And after exchanging business cards with Ryoka Tsurugi
and wrapping up the briefing session on 'U.A.F.'—

—And so, alongside <chrname>,
the challenge for the "U.A.F." began.

First, let's practice aiming for results
at the trial tournament at the end of the year!
